snippet.title: Transport Fever 3 - First Look: Tycoon
snippet.description:
In this series of First Look videos, players will get to see new features of Transport Fever 3 for the first time. In this latest episode, we're looking at the tycoon gameplay and how your transport networks and the decisions that go into making them will shape cities and the regions surrounding them. We're showing off the new city demand system, company headquarters, landmarks and more, while discussing how the way your towns evolve has changed in the new game.

This video has been recorded entirely within Transport Fever 3. It uses a combination of beta-stage gameplay footage, "in-camera" video, where shots have been captured using the in-game camera tool with no special adjustments, and "in-engine", where the same camera tool is used but draw distances and rendering limits have been increased beyond normal levels. 

No post-processing has been done on any of this footage.
 
Transport Fever 3 will be released in 2026 and is also coming to Mac and Linux!
